title: Zephyrine and the Asset
author: Odile Coldharbour
blurb: Casper Nystrom, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
